rules.statement: The test to be applied in ascertaining the value of the interest which the appeal involves is that referred to by Lord Selborne in Allan v. Pratt, where the judgment is to be looked at as it affects the interests of the party who is prejudiced by it and seeks to relieve himself from it by appeal.
rules.supporting_quote: "the judgment is to be looked at as it affects the interests of the party who is prejudiced by it, and who seeks to relieve himself from it by appeal"
